items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Lil' Frank Moyer's sister was Alec Frasier's wife.

ctx.x: Yeah, well he died a young man, but he had a little age on him when he died. Played plenty of piano, but never gotten a chance to play too many nightclubs or anything like that. He taught his wife a gang of piano. Lil' Frank Moyer's sister was Alec Frasier's wife. You remember Lil' Frank Moyer?
